coordinate: depth = contact_center_gap_m - lower_axis dot (upper_reference_point - lower_reference_point); positive inward
reference_points: Must match measured coordinate. Synthetic pair uses COMs. TCP/wrench-only data identify a lumped grip/fixture/servo response, not independent brick contact.
curve_requirements: First depth, elastic force and damping zero; strictly increasing depths; nonnegative damping; exact integrated elastic potential nonnegative relative to separated zero; outside depth range rejected.
supported: axial entry barrier and post-contact potential well if supplied by identified curve
unsupported: separate grip, fixture and brick parameter identification from TCP-only data
